meta.purpose: ASSORTMENT BAR - drives catalog/catalog.json. Our catalog must cover at least these categories, variant dimensions and accessory links, under our own product names.
meta.sources: WebSearch index snippets of outmate.nl and its sister sites (snapshots 1 month to 2+ years old). WebFetch/curl blocked. Raw research: scratchpad research-raw.json.
meta.statafelshop_status: NO DATA. Both Statafelshop/market research agents hit the shared 200-search budget before running a single query. Every Statafelshop item below is taken from gauntlet/BRIEF.md section 1 and is unconfirmed.
meta.price_rules: eur_incl_btw = Outmate consumer price incl. 21% btw as seen in search snippets. kind: from = 'vanaf' price, fixed = single price, range = see note, approx = rounded. Use as calibration only; our prices are suggestions flagged in docs/claims-to-confirm.md.
meta.naming_rule: Do not reuse Outmate model/brand names (Starmate, AirMate Alpha/Beta/Theta/Hexon, Times Square, Tundra, Helsinki, Ibiza, Blomo, Supercombi, Skyshade, Wikinger, Mundo, Paxi, Louis, Hamburg, Naxos, X4trail, Foldtable). They are listed only to identify reference items.

categories.notes: Two lines. On Outmate each size and each canopy type is its own product (separate URL); category text says 3x3-4x8 but 2x2 and 5x5 Professional exist. Full Colour print is a value of the colour option.
